facts.en: Earned a Bachelor of Science in psychology at Fictional Elmflavour University in 2017.
facts.zh: 2017 年在虚构榆味大学获得心理学理学学士学位。

facts.en: Paid meeting coordinator at Fictional Bramblehall Services from 2017-09 to 2021-12.
facts.zh: 2017-09 至 2021-12 在虚构荆棘厅服务公司任有薪会议协调员。

facts.en: At that employer, managed participant reminders, room schedules and attendance records.
facts.zh: 在该雇主处管理参与者提醒、房间日程及出席记录。

facts.en: Worked as a paid sensory study operations assistant at Fictional Pebbletaste Research, with an unresolved start month in 2022 and a documented end date of 2026-08.
facts.zh: 在虚构卵味研究公司任有薪感官研究运营助理，2022 年入职月份尚未确定，已记录离职日期为 2026-08。

facts.en: An onboarding checklist states 2022-02, while the candidate’s work-history draft states 2022-03; the supplied documents do not resolve the difference.
facts.zh: 入职核对表写明 2022-02，而候选人工作经历草稿写明 2022-03；所供文件未解决该差异。

facts.en: Schedules participants from an approved roster and sends standardized preparation reminders.
facts.zh: 依据获批名单安排参与者，并发送标准化准备提醒。

facts.en: Labels sample cups with assigned anonymous codes and follows the study lead’s serving sequence.
facts.zh: 使用分配的匿名代码标注样品杯，并遵循研究负责人指定的呈样顺序。

facts.en: Records attendance and questionnaire receipt separately to avoid assuming every attendee supplied a response.
facts.zh: 分别记录出席及问卷收取情况，避免假定每位出席者都提交回答。

facts.en: The study lead sets eligibility, screening rules and research design; the candidate applies the approved operations checklist.
facts.zh: 研究负责人制定资格、筛选规则及研究设计；候选人执行获批运营核对表。

facts.en: Coordinated room and sample-code logistics for a 2025-09 fictional snack preference study.
facts.zh: 为一项 2025-09 虚构零食偏好研究协调房间及样品代码事务。

facts.en: The session log records 60 attendees and 57 completed questionnaires, with no result reported for the 3 nonrespondents.
facts.zh: 活动日志记录 60 名出席者及 57 份已完成问卷，未报告 3 名未作答者的结果。

facts.en: Personally checked code-to-tray assignments and counted returned questionnaires; an analyst interpreted preference results.
facts.zh: 个人核对代码与托盘的对应关系，并清点收回问卷；偏好结果由分析员解释。

facts.en: Uses scheduling spreadsheets, coded sample lists and controlled study checklists.
facts.zh: 使用排程电子表格、编码样品清单及受控研究核对表。

facts.en: Completed internal study-room hygiene and incident-reporting induction in 2022.
facts.zh: 2022 年完成内部研究室卫生及事件上报入职培训。

facts.en: Reports participant concerns or unexpected sample issues to the study lead and pauses the affected serving task pending instructions.
facts.zh: 向研究负责人报告参与者提出的顾虑或样品异常，并暂停受影响的呈样任务，等待指示。

facts.en: Volunteered with Fictional Willowcup Board-Game Club from 2019-01 to 2021-08, scheduling casual game nights.
facts.zh: 2019-01 至 2021-08 在虚构柳杯桌游社做志愿者，安排休闲游戏之夜。

facts.en: For that club, created a reusable game-component checklist and co-designed an informal preference poll about game themes.
facts.zh: 为该社制作可复用游戏配件核对表，并共同设计关于游戏主题的非正式偏好调查。

facts.en: Keeps a personal notebook comparing imagined flavour combinations for creative writing, without commercial product trials.
facts.zh: 保留个人笔记，比较想象中的风味组合用于创意写作，不涉及商业产品试验。

facts.en: Enjoys making illustrated recipe cards for fictional foods and playing cooperative board games.
facts.zh: 爱好为虚构食物制作图解食谱卡，以及玩合作式桌游。

facts.en: Prepares post-session handovers covering unused samples, missing forms and issues awaiting study-lead review.
facts.zh: 准备活动后交接，涵盖未使用样品、缺失表单及等待研究负责人审核的问题。
